agent.finish_summary: Fixed regression in sqlparse/filters/others.py: StripWhitespaceFilter.process had the trailing-whitespace-trim condition inverted (`depth != 0` instead of `depth == 0`), which caused the outermost statement to retain a trailing whitespace token, breaking ReindentFilter's blank-line logic between statements (e.g. 'select foo; select bar' reindented incorrectly). Reverted to `if depth == 0 and stmt.tokens and stmt.tokens[-1].is_whitespace:`. Verified against the full upstream test suite from a reference checkout: 506 passed, 2 xfailed, 1 xpassed, no failures, including all test_stmts assertions.
